reason: We have actually decided to go into the new market and I have no pipeline there, so a free list of 15 real targets and three free meetings costs me only a call and a few hours. I would take the free step and probably start the pilot, but I would not pay for anything until I see the first meetings are real buyers.
objection: My name is on those emails. If some agency spams buyers in a market where nobody knows us yet, or a German or Romanian buyer complains about GDPR, that hurts us before we even start. And one logistics client with 45 meetings is not much proof for a wholesaler like me.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 target companies are obvious names I already know, or the first messages sound like generic spam, I walk away. A reference I can call from a wholesaler or distributor would make me commit faster.
